meta.title: Bulk PR Upload: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Determine whether the current tenant is below Growth or on Growth/Enterprise.
Switch between a lower-plan tenant and a Growth tenant while keeping the same Procurement Manager user role.
Observe whether the Bulk PR Upload capability is absent or refused specifically because of the plan.
Execute Bulk PR Upload using a template and verify that the upload works on Growth.
Compare the same bulk-upload flow's outcome across the two plans.
